# occurrence of series

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries`](gmeow-occurrenceOfSeries.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/occurrenceOfSeries>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/events`](../../slices/events.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

Relates a concrete event occurrence to the series that issued it; the inverse of [`gmeow:seriesOccurrence`](gmeow-seriesOccurrence.md).

**Property shape:** object property; [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) -> [`gmeow:EventSeries`](../classes/gmeow-EventSeries.md)

Use [`gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries`](gmeow-occurrenceOfSeries.md) from [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) to [`gmeow:EventSeries`](../classes/gmeow-EventSeries.md) when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to link a concrete [`gmeow:Event`](../classes/gmeow-Event.md) back to the [`gmeow:EventSeries`](../classes/gmeow-EventSeries.md) that issued it — the occurrence-rooted direction of the planned/actual relation.

### Avoid when

- Avoid asserting it when [`gmeow:seriesOccurrence`](gmeow-seriesOccurrence.md) reads more naturally (the series-rooted inverse).

### How to use

- Assert [`gmeow:occurrenceOfSeries`](gmeow-occurrenceOfSeries.md) from the occurrence, or its inverse [`gmeow:seriesOccurrence`](gmeow-seriesOccurrence.md) from the series; read both ways.
